narr-intro.text: Once upon a time, in a sparkling pink castle, Princess Kathleen woke up in her beautiful bedroom. The sun was peeking through the curtains... and something magical was about to happen.
narr-intro.speaker: narrator

narr-fairy-arrives.text: Suddenly, with a twinkle and a shimmer, a little fairy appeared!
narr-fairy-arrives.speaker: narrator

fairy-intro.text: Oh, Princess Kathleen! The five magic keys have disappeared! Without them, we can't open the castle's enchanted door. Can you help me find them?
fairy-intro.speaker: fairy

fairy-start.text: Let's look all around your room. Tap on things to see what's hiding!
fairy-start.speaker: fairy

fairy-found-1.text: You found one! Hooray! Four more to go!
fairy-found-1.speaker: fairy

fairy-found-2.text: Another magic key! Two keys! You're so clever, Kathleen!
fairy-found-2.speaker: fairy

fairy-found-3.text: Three keys! Wow, you're a wonderful explorer! Only two more!
fairy-found-3.speaker: fairy

fairy-found-4.text: Four keys! Just one more to find. I know you can do it!
fairy-found-4.speaker: fairy

fairy-found-5.text: Five keys! You found them all, Princess Kathleen!
fairy-found-5.speaker: fairy

hint-teddy-1.text: I think Teddy is hiding something...
hint-teddy-1.speaker: fairy

hint-teddy-2.text: Teddy looks a little bit wiggly. Maybe give him a tap?
hint-teddy-2.speaker: fairy

hint-teddy-3.text: What could be behind Teddy? Let's ask him to move over!
hint-teddy-3.speaker: fairy

hint-teddy-4.text: Teddy is sitting on something shiny!
hint-teddy-4.speaker: fairy

hint-jewellery-1.text: Something sparkly is in the jewellery box...
hint-jewellery-1.speaker: fairy

hint-jewellery-2.text: Ooh, the pretty pink box on your dressing table... I wonder what's inside?
hint-jewellery-2.speaker: fairy

hint-jewellery-3.text: Princesses keep their treasures in a jewellery box. Try opening the lid!
hint-jewellery-3.speaker: fairy

hint-jewellery-4.text: I can hear something jingling in the little pink box!
hint-jewellery-4.speaker: fairy

hint-curtain-1.text: The curtains are moving in the breeze...
hint-curtain-1.speaker: fairy

hint-curtain-2.text: Something is twinkling behind the curtains by the window!
hint-curtain-2.speaker: fairy

hint-curtain-3.text: Let's open the curtains and let the starlight in!
hint-curtain-3.speaker: fairy

hint-curtain-4.text: Peek behind the big pink curtains, Kathleen!
hint-curtain-4.speaker: fairy

hint-wardrobe-1.text: Have you looked inside the wardrobe?
hint-wardrobe-1.speaker: fairy

hint-wardrobe-2.text: So many pretty dresses live in your wardrobe... Let's open the doors!
hint-wardrobe-2.speaker: fairy

hint-wardrobe-3.text: One of the dresses has a little pocket. What's in it?
hint-wardrobe-3.speaker: fairy

hint-wardrobe-4.text: Look closely at the pink dress in the middle!
hint-wardrobe-4.speaker: fairy

hint-mirror-2.text: Magic mirror, magic mirror! Try giving it a tap.
hint-mirror-2.speaker: fairy

hint-mirror-3.text: The mirror is twinkling... tap the stars!
hint-mirror-3.speaker: fairy

hint-mirror-4.text: Tap the stars one, two, three, from the top to the bottom!
hint-mirror-4.speaker: fairy

hint-mirror-5.text: Oops, let's try the stars again. Start with the top star!
hint-mirror-5.speaker: fairy

hint-general-1.text: Keep exploring! Magic keys love to hide.
hint-general-1.speaker: fairy

hint-general-2.text: Tap on anything that looks interesting!
hint-general-2.speaker: fairy

hint-general-3.text: Hmm... where haven't we looked yet?
hint-general-3.speaker: fairy

curious-musicbox.text: Ooh, what a lovely song! Look at the little ballerina dance!
curious-musicbox.speaker: fairy

curious-kitten.text: Hello, kitty! She wants to play!
curious-kitten.speaker: fairy

curious-dragon.text: The little dragon is giggling! That tickles!
curious-dragon.speaker: fairy

curious-bed.text: What a cosy bed! But no keys under the pillows.
curious-bed.speaker: fairy

curious-door-locked.text: The golden door is locked tight. We need all five magic keys!
curious-door-locked.speaker: fairy

curious-books.text: So many storybooks! Maybe we'll read one later.
curious-books.speaker: fairy

fairy-door-glow.text: Look! The golden door is glowing! Tap the door, Kathleen!
fairy-door-glow.speaker: fairy

narr-unlock.text: One by one, the five magic keys flew into the golden locks... click, click, click, click, click! And the enchanted door swung open.
narr-unlock.speaker: narrator

fairy-final.text: You did it, Princess Kathleen! You're a wonderful treasure hunter! Now our magical adventure can begin!
fairy-final.speaker: fairy

narr-complete.text: And so, Princess Kathleen and her fairy friend stepped through the glowing door... To be continued!
narr-complete.speaker: narrator

narr-title.text: Princess Kathleen and the Five Magic Keys. Chapter One: The Princess's Bedroom.
narr-title.speaker: narrator
